The '''park warden''' is a [[character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[EP248|One Trick Phony!]]''. He is in charge of the {{jo|Battle Park}}.

He brought {{TRT}}, who was working at the battle facility, more boxes of dirty {{i|Poké Ball}}s for cleaning and laughed off their disdain, saying he had the hard task of shopping and left Team Rocket in charge of the park while he went to get supplies.

Later, when Team Rocket flew off with the Poké Balls and [[Ash's Pikachu]], the warden ran out telling them that the Poké Balls belong to the Battle Park. After [[Ash's Totodile]] and [[Misty's Politoed]] brought down their [[Team Rocket's mechas|balloon]], [[Jessie]] and [[James]] sent out {{p|Venusaur}}, {{p|Charizard}}, and {{p|Blastoise}} to battle {{Ash}} and {{ashfr}}. However, the [[rental Pokémon]] turned on them, as they were only obedient inside the park and blasted the trio off.
